module WorkspaceServer.Connection
expose Connection, Runner, Acceptor, Gate, Token, Identity, Reading, Next, Candidates, Handlers, fresh, took, ended, with_length, status_of

use WorkspaceServer.Admission{Admission, Admitted}
use WorkspaceServer.Envelope{Envelope, Ids, refused, ids_of, text}
use WorkspaceServer.Journal{Journal}
use WorkspaceServer.Schema{Call, call}
use WorkspaceServer.Wire{Head, Refusal, head, head_fits?, response, malformed, too_large}
use WorkspaceServer.Worker{Worker}

intent "Serve candidate connections, one process each from accept to close, so no descriptor is shared or reused while another holds it: read bounded byte chunks, decode a header or body only once all of its required bytes are present, refuse what the contract refuses, have the gate compare the token, and hand a whole call to the connection's runner. A request not whole in two seconds is refused; input EOF after a whole request is only read_ended and never closes admission or cancels execution; a bounded response is still attempted, its local write is recorded separately from receipt, which is always unknown without an acknowledgment; a failed write or response timeout closes admission without ending the operator path."

never "the token reaches a candidate's connection"
  flows(Token, into: Conn)
end

never "the token reaches the journal"
  flows(Token, into: Handle(Journal))
end

never "the token reaches a file"
  flows(Token, into: Fs)
end

# The candidate token: 64 hex characters, held by the gate alone.
type Token = String where value.byte_size == 64

# What every connection knows of the run.
struct Identity
  run_id: String
  workspace_id: String
  port: UInt16
  commands: Bool
end

# The request so far. Before the head is complete, parts hold the wire bytes through the
# delimiter search. Afterwards they hold only body bytes. `bytes` is exact in either phase;
# `marker` is the matched CRLF CRLF prefix and `header_end` fixes its first complete offset
# without repeatedly flattening the parts. A positive `length` marks the body phase because
# Content-Length is canonical and positive.
struct Reading
  parts: List(List(UInt8))
  bytes: UInt64
  length: UInt64
  marker: UInt64
  header_end: Option(UInt64)
end

enum Next
  Wait
  HeadDone(head: Head, reading: Reading)
  Whole(body: String)
  Refuse(refusal: Refusal)
end

fn fresh() : Reading
  Reading(parts: [], bytes: 0, length: 0, marker: 0, header_end: None)
end

fn with_length(r: Reading, length: UInt64) : Reading
  Reading(parts: r.parts, bytes: r.bytes, length: length, marker: r.marker,
    header_end: r.header_end)
end

# Advance the first CRLF CRLF search across one chunk. The returned offset includes all four
# bytes and is absolute across prior chunks.
fn scanned(marker: UInt64, before: UInt64, bytes: List(UInt8)) : (UInt64, Option(UInt64))
  var matched = marker
  var consumed = 0
  for byte in bytes
    consumed += 1
    matched = case matched
      0:
        case byte
          13: 1
          _: 0
        end
      1:
        case byte
          10: 2
          13: 1
          _: 0
        end
      2:
        case byte
          13: 3
          _: 0
        end
      3:
        case byte
          10: 4
          13: 1
          _: 0
        end
      _: 4
    end
    if matched == 4
      return (matched, Some(before + consumed))
    end
  end
  (matched, None)
end

fn appended(r: Reading, bytes: List(UInt8)) : Reading
  if r.length > 0
    return Reading(parts: r.parts.push(bytes), bytes: r.bytes + bytes.size, length: r.length,
      marker: r.marker, header_end: r.header_end)
  end
  scan = scanned(r.marker, r.bytes, bytes)
  Reading(parts: r.parts.push(bytes), bytes: r.bytes + bytes.size, length: 0, marker: scan.0,
    header_end: scan.1)
end

# A body is decoded only at its exact declared byte length. More bytes are pipelining and
# malformed; fewer remain byte data rather than becoming replacement-character text.
fn body_step(r: Reading) : Next
  return Refuse(refusal: malformed()) if r.bytes > r.length
  return Wait if r.bytes < r.length
  case String.from_bytes(r.parts.flat_map(fn(part) part end))
    Some(body): Whole(body: body)
    None: Refuse(refusal: malformed())
  end
end

# Project the coalesced bytes after a complete header into the body reading. The caller
# flattens once; this keeps the header result and any coalesced body bytes together.
fn head_result(grown: Reading, whole: List(UInt8), end_at: UInt64,
  parsed: Head) : (Reading, Next)
  bytes = whole.drop(end_at)
  parts = case bytes.size
    0: []
    _: [bytes]
  end
  body = with_length(Reading(parts: parts, bytes: bytes.size, length: 0, marker: 0,
    header_end: None),
    parsed.length)
  (grown, HeadDone(head: parsed, reading: body))
end

# Find a complete bounded header section in bytes. The limit includes CRLF CRLF exactly, as
# the Python reference does. Only then decode ASCII-shaped text and validate its fields.
fn head_step(r: Reading, bytes: List(UInt8), port: UInt16) : (Reading, Next)
  grown = appended(r, bytes)
  case grown.header_end
    None:
      if head_fits?(grown.bytes)
        (grown, Wait)
      else
        (grown, Refuse(refusal: too_large()))
      end
    Some(end_at):
      if !head_fits?(end_at)
        return (grown, Refuse(refusal: too_large()))
      end
      whole = grown.parts.flat_map(fn(part) part end)
      case String.from_bytes(whole.take(end_at - 4))
        None: (grown, Refuse(refusal: malformed()))
        Some(text):
          case head(text.split("\r\n"), port)
            Error(refusal): (grown, Refuse(refusal: refusal))
            Ok(parsed): head_result(grown, whole, end_at, parsed)
          end
      end
  end
end

fn took(r: Reading, bytes: List(UInt8), port: UInt16) : (Reading, Next)
  if r.length == 0
    head_step(r, bytes, port)
  else
    grown = appended(r, bytes)
    (grown, body_step(grown))
  end
end

# Input EOF never completes an unfinished request. A body already at its exact byte count can
# still be projected, though the chunk source normally delivered and dispatched it first.
fn ended(r: Reading) : Next
  return Refuse(refusal: malformed()) if r.length == 0 or r.bytes != r.length
  body_step(r)
end

# The door: at most `limit` live candidate connections, and the one holder of the token, which
# it compares in constant time and never gives out.
process Gate(limit: UInt64, token: Token)
  state
    inside: UInt64
  end

  invariant "no more connections are inside than the limit"
    state.inside <= limit
  end

  message Enter : Bool
  message Leave
  message Count : UInt64
  message Check(offered: String) : Bool

  fn update(state, message)
    case message
      Enter:
        if state.inside < limit
          state.inside += 1
          true
        else
          false
        end
      Leave:
        state.inside = state.inside.saturating_sub(1)
      Count: state.inside
      Check(offered): Hash.equal?(Hash.sha256(offered.bytes), Hash.sha256(token.bytes))
    end
  end
end

# The status and envelope an admitted call's wait came to.
fn status_of(got: Result(Envelope, AskError), call: Call) : (UInt16, Envelope)
  ids = Some(ids_of(call))
  case got
    Ok(envelope): (200, envelope)
    Error(Timeout):
      (504,
        Envelope(ids: ids, accepted: true, state: "timeout", execution: "unknown",
        error: Some("response_timeout"), result: None))
    Error(Down):
      (200,
        Envelope(ids: ids, accepted: true, state: "failure", execution: "unknown",
        error: Some("owner_unknown"), result: None))
  end
end

# One connection's calls to admission, the worker and the journal. It asks admission, waits
# for the worker at most the call's wait, journals the reply produced before the connection
# writes it, then records read-end, local write and unknown client receipt separately.
process Runner(admission: Handle(Admission), worker: Handle(Worker), journal: Handle(Journal))
  state
    call_id: String
  end

  message Go(back: Handle(Connection), call: Call, payload_sha256: String)
  message Delivery(written: Bool, read_ended: Bool)

  fn update(state, message)
    case message
      Go(back: back, call: call, payload_sha256: sha):
        state.call_id = call.call_id
        case admission.ask(Admit(call_id: call.call_id, payload_sha256: sha,
          operation: call.operation),
          within: 1_000.ms)
          Ok(Yes(core_id: core_id, wait_ms: wait_ms)):
            got = status_of(worker.ask(Do(call: call, core_id: core_id), within: wait_ms.ms), call)
            closes(admission, got.1, got.0)
            reply = "{\"status\": #{got.0}, \"state\": \"#{got.1.state}\", \"execution\": \"#{got.1.execution}\", \"error\": #{Json.encode(got.1.error or "")}}"
            noted = journal.ask(Replied(call_id: call.call_id, reply: reply),
              within: 1_000.ms) == Ok(true)
            back.send(Reply(status: got.0, envelope: got.1, journaled: noted))
          Ok(No(error)): back.send(Refused(error: error))
          Error(_):
            admission.send(Close(why: "admission_unknown"))
            back.send(Refused(error: "admission_closed"))
        end
      Delivery(written: written, read_ended: read_ended):
        if !written
          admission.send(Close(why: "response_write_unknown"))
        end
        local_write = if written: "completed" else: "failed"
        delivery = "{\"client_receipt\": \"unknown\", \"local_write\": \"#{local_write}\", \"read_ended\": #{read_ended}}"
        noted = journal.ask(Delivered(call_id: state.call_id, delivery: delivery, unknown: true),
          within: 1_000.ms)
        state.call_id = if noted == Ok(true): "" else: state.call_id
    end
  end
end

# A reply that is a wait expired, an owner lost, or an unknown execution closes admission.
fn closes(admission: Handle(Admission), envelope: Envelope, status: UInt16)
  if status == 504
    admission.send(Close(why: "response_timeout"))
  else
    if envelope.execution == "unknown"
      admission.send(Close(why: if envelope.error == Some("owner_unknown")
        "owner_unknown"
      else
        "unknown_execution"
      end))
    end
  end
end

process Connection(conn: Conn, identity: Identity, gate: Handle(Gate), runner: Handle(Runner))
  state
    me: Option(Handle(Connection))
    reading: Reading = fresh()
    phase: String = "head"
    ids: Option(Ids)
    read_ended: Bool
  end

  message Begin(me: Handle(Connection))
  message Chunk(bytes: List(UInt8))
  message Closed
  message Idle
  message Expire
  message Reply(status: UInt16, envelope: Envelope, journaled: Bool)
  message Refused(error: String)

  fn update(state, message)
    case message
      Begin(me):
        state.me = Some(me)
      Chunk(bytes) if reading?(state.phase):
        step = took(state.reading, bytes, identity.port)
        state.reading = step.0
        case step.1
          HeadDone(head: parsed, reading: body):
            transition = head_transition(conn, identity, gate, runner, state.me, state.reading,
              state.ids, parsed, body)
            state.phase = transition.0
            state.reading = transition.1
            state.ids = transition.2
          Wait | Whole(_) | Refuse(_):
            phase = next_phase(conn, identity, gate, runner, state.me, step.1)
            state.phase = if phase == "same": state.phase else: phase
            state.ids = if state.phase == "running"
              ids_in(body_of(step.1), identity)
            else
              state.ids
            end
        end
      Chunk(_):
        if state.phase == "running"
          conn.close
        end
      Closed:
        if state.phase == "running"
          state.read_ended = true
        end
        if reading?(state.phase)
          whole = ended(state.reading)
          state.phase = next_phase(conn, identity, gate, runner, state.me, whole)
          state.ids = if state.phase == "running": ids_in(body_of(whole), identity) else: state.ids
        end
      Idle:
        state.read_ended = state.phase == "running"
      Expire:
        if reading?(state.phase)
          state.phase = refuse(conn, gate, malformed())
        end
      Reply(status: status, envelope: envelope, journaled: _):
        state.phase = answered(conn, gate, status, envelope)
        runner.send(Delivery(written: state.phase == "done", read_ended: state.read_ended))
      Refused(error):
        state.phase = answered(conn, gate, 409, refused(state.ids, error))
    end
  end
end

fn reading?(phase: String) : Bool
  phase == "head" or phase == "body"
end

fn body_of(next: Next) : String
  case next
    Whole(body): body
    Wait | HeadDone(head: _, reading: _) | Refuse(_): ""
  end
end

fn ids_in(body: String, identity: Identity) : Option(Ids)
  case call(body, identity.run_id, identity.workspace_id)
    Ok(c): Some(ids_of(c))
    Error(_): None
  end
end

# The phase a body step leads to, with its effects: a refusal written or a whole request handed
# to the runner; "same" when it waits for more. HeadDone is consumed by Connection before here.
fn next_phase(conn: Conn, identity: Identity, gate: Handle(Gate), runner: Handle(Runner),
  me: Option(Handle(Connection)), next: Next) : String
  case next
    Wait | HeadDone(head: _, reading: _): "same"
    Refuse(refusal): refuse(conn, gate, refusal)
    Whole(body): dispatched(conn, identity, gate, runner, me, body)
  end
end

# Authenticate one complete header, then project and dispatch its coalesced body step. A refused
# token keeps the accumulated header reading; an authorized request moves to the body reading.
fn head_transition(conn: Conn, identity: Identity, gate: Handle(Gate), runner: Handle(Runner),
  me: Option(Handle(Connection)), current: Reading, ids: Option(Ids), parsed: Head,
  body: Reading) : (String, Reading, Option(Ids))
  if gate.ask(Check(offered: parsed.offered), within: 1_000.ms) != Ok(true)
    return (refuse(conn, gate, Refusal(status: 401, error: "unauthorized")), current, ids)
  end
  next = body_step(body)
  phase = next_phase(conn, identity, gate, runner, me, next)
  advanced = if phase == "same": "body" else: phase
  next_ids = if advanced == "running"
    ids_in(body_of(next), identity)
  else
    ids
  end
  (advanced, body, next_ids)
end

fn dispatched(conn: Conn, identity: Identity, gate: Handle(Gate), runner: Handle(Runner),
  me: Option(Handle(Connection)), body: String) : String
  case call(body, identity.run_id, identity.workspace_id)
    Error(refusal): refuse(conn, gate, refusal)
    Ok(c):
      if c.operation == "command" and !identity.commands
        return answered(conn, gate, 409, refused(Some(ids_of(c)), "request_refused"))
      end
      case me
        Some(back):
          runner.send(Go(back: back, call: c, payload_sha256: Hash.hex(Hash.sha256(body.bytes))))
          "running"
        None: answered(conn, gate, 409, refused(Some(ids_of(c)), "admission_closed"))
      end
  end
end

# A refusal before admission: written, the connection closed, its gate slot given back.
fn refuse(conn: Conn, gate: Handle(Gate), refusal: Refusal) : String
  answered(conn, gate, refusal.status, refused(None, refusal.error))
end

fn answered(conn: Conn, gate: Handle(Gate), status: UInt16, envelope: Envelope) : String
  wrote = conn.write(response(status, text(envelope)), within: 2_000.ms) is Ok(_)
  conn.close
  gate.send(Leave)
  if wrote: "done" else: "unwritten"
end

# Accepts candidate connections: four at most live; each gets a connection process and a
# runner, the runtime reads bounded byte chunks into it, and it is told when its two seconds end.
process Acceptor(identity: Identity, gate: Handle(Gate), admission: Handle(Admission),
  worker: Handle(Worker), journal: Handle(Journal))
  state
    accepted: UInt64
    turned_away: UInt64
  end

  message Accepted(conn: Conn)
  message Idle

  fn update(state, message)
    case message
      Accepted(conn):
        if gate.ask(Enter, within: 1_000.ms) == Ok(true)
          handler = Connection.start(conn, identity, gate, Runner.start(admission, worker, journal))
          handler.send(Begin(me: handler))
          conn.chunks(into: handler, max_bytes: 65_536, idle: 310_000.ms)
          handler.send(Expire, delay: 2_000.ms)
          state.accepted += 1
        else
          conn.close
          state.turned_away += 1
        end
      Idle:
        state.accepted += 0
    end
  end
end

supervisor Candidates(identity: Identity, token: Token, gate: Handle(Gate),
  admission: Handle(Admission), worker: Handle(Worker), journal: Handle(Journal))
  child Gate(4, token), restart: :never
  child Acceptor(identity, gate, admission, worker, journal), restart: :always
  child Runner(admission, worker, journal), restart: :never
end

supervisor Handlers(conn: Conn, identity: Identity, gate: Handle(Gate), runner: Handle(Runner))
  child Connection(conn, identity, gate, runner), restart: :never
end

test "a complete unchanged-wire body is whole before EOF across arbitrary chunks"
  raw = "POST /tool HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 127.0.0.1:9\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nContent-Length: 2\r\nX-Mo-Workspace-Token: abc\r\n\r\n{}".bytes
  first = took(fresh(), raw.take(37), 9)
  assert first.1 == Wait
  second = took(first.0, raw.drop(37), 9)
  assert second.1 is HeadDone(head: parsed, reading: body)
  assert parsed == Head(length: 2, offered: "abc")
  assert body_step(body) == Whole(body: "{}")
end

test "body byte length, trailing bytes and UTF-8 are decided only when complete"
  waiting = with_length(Reading(parts: [["é".bytes.first or 0]], bytes: 1, length: 0, marker: 0,
    header_end: None),
    2)
  assert body_step(waiting) == Wait
  whole = took(waiting, ["é".bytes.last or 0], 9)
  assert whole.1 == Whole(body: "é")
  assert took(with_length(fresh(), 2), "{}x".bytes, 9).1 == Refuse(refusal: malformed())
  assert took(with_length(fresh(), 1), [255], 9).1 == Refuse(refusal: malformed())
end

test "the full header section has an exact byte cap and unfinished EOF is malformed"
  exact = took(fresh(), "#{"x".repeat(16_380)}\r\n\r\n".bytes, 9)
  assert exact.1 == Refuse(refusal: malformed())
  over = took(fresh(), "#{"x".repeat(16_381)}\r\n\r\n".bytes, 9)
  assert over.1 == Refuse(refusal: too_large())
  unfinished = took(fresh(), "x".repeat(16_385).bytes, 9)
  assert unfinished.1 == Refuse(refusal: too_large())
  assert ended(took(fresh(), "POST /tool HTTP/1.1\r\n".bytes, 9).0) == Refuse(refusal: malformed())
end

test "the gate lets four in, and compares the token in constant time"
  gate = Gate.start(4, "a".repeat(64))
  assert gate.ask(Check(offered: "a".repeat(64)), within: 1.minute) == Ok(true)
  assert gate.ask(Check(offered: "wrong"), within: 1.minute) == Ok(false)
  assert gate.ask(Enter, within: 1.minute) == Ok(true)
  assert gate.ask(Enter, within: 1.minute) == Ok(true)
  assert gate.ask(Enter, within: 1.minute) == Ok(true)
  assert gate.ask(Enter, within: 1.minute) == Ok(true)
  assert gate.ask(Enter, within: 1.minute) == Ok(false)
  gate.send(Leave)
  assert gate.ask(Count, within: 1.minute) == Ok(3)
end

test "a wait past its deadline is 504 with execution unknown; an owner lost is 200 owner_unknown"
  c = Call(run_id: "r", workspace_id: "w", call_id: "c", operation: "read_file", args: Map.new(),
    timeout_ms: 0)
  late = status_of(Error(Timeout), c)
  assert (late.0, late.1.execution, late.1.error) == (504, "unknown", Some("response_timeout"))
  lost = status_of(Error(Down), c)
  assert (lost.0, lost.1.error) == (200, Some("owner_unknown"))
end
